stem_book: [Choose one or more than one correct options] If sinθ + √3cosθ = 6x − x² − 11, 0 ≤ θ ≤ 4π, x ∈ R holds for (a) no values of x and θ (b) one value of x and two values of θ (c) two values of x and two values of θ (d) two pairs of values of (x, θ)
work: LHS = 2sin(θ + π/3) ≥ −2, RHS = −2 − (x − 3)² ≤ −2 ⇒ x = 3, θ + π/3 = 3π/2 + 2kπ ⇒ θ = 7π/6, 19π/6 ⇒ one x, two θ, two pairs
